texts.text:
iSupport-D is developed by a multidisciplinary team of researchers and collaborators dedicated to improving support for people living with dementia and those who care for them.
Our team brings together expertise in digital health, dementia care, public health, and culturally inclusive healthcare, with extensive experience designing and evaluating caregiver support programs in Australia and internationally.
Through iSupport-D, we aim to improve caregiving skills, wellbeing, and access to culturally appropriate support for family carers and the professionals who support them.
Swinburne University of Technology and  National Ageing Research Institute
Empowering Dementia Carers with iSupport Digital.
